proposition: Ibn Turka wrote three letters to Amīr Yūsuf Khwāja (governor from Sultaniyya to Qom): a greeting (5), a welcome on the amir's arrival in Persian Iraq (9), and in letter 25 (ca. 829/1426?) a complaint that dīvān officials were harassing him despite his customary standing as Fars's leading man of letters, with a request for intervention.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Amīr Yūsuf Khwāja
mediation.note: Written by a supplicant asking a ruler or official for clemency, relief or a stipend; framed to win the favour asked, not as a neutral report.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: Dates and place of letter 25 are queried by MK
